outcome: Prevention of irreversible spinal cord dysfunction
cohort: Two preschool-aged brothers with Maroteaux-Lamy (MPS type VI) syndrome and craniovertebral stenosis.
finding: Maroteaux-Lamy (MPS type VI) syndrome can have familial forms with a similar course of craniovertebral stenosis in siblings, and timely surgical treatment is recommended to prevent irreversible spinal cord dysfunction.
